svg.title: How to get help — autism early intervention flowchart
svg.desc: A step-by-step flowchart guiding parents from noticing early signs through pediatrician screening, diagnosis, and connecting with services, with bilingual English and Chinese labels.

g.text: 联系您的儿科医生 — 请求筛查
申请发育评估 (专科医生)
联系早期干预服务 (0–3 yrs: call 1-800-734-0461)
开始治疗: 行为、语言、职业疗法

svg.text: Questions? Visit emmaz-sv.github.io/early-autism-awareness or talk to your pediatrician
